params.name: base
params.description: Base currency code (ISO 4217). Defaults to USD.

params.name: currencies
params.description: Comma-separated list of currency codes to return. Defaults to all supported currencies.

params.name: api_key
params.description: Optional API key. May also be supplied via the Authorization Bearer header.

items.docs: Returns the most recent exchange rates for the requested base currency. Confirmed to respond with HTTP 200 without an API key for a limited tier.
